Name: Polish Cuisine
Author: Rosieyama
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It's my first mod I've ever made, hope it's at least decent to use. Adds to the game new recipes based on dishes appearing in Polish dining tables.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]It supports i18n translations. Feel free to add other languages just give me a sign you want to translate. Current supported language is English. In future I might add Polish version.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]If there's some issues or needed correction with graphics (I'm just learning how to do them) or with descriptions, contact me and I'll try my best to change them.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]In future might be added new recipes.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires mods: [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Category  Ingredient Display Fix[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and Category Ingredient Display Fix if you haven't already done it.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Download Polish Cuisine and unzip it to StardewValley/Mods folder on your device.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Launch game on SMAPI[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Currently adds 10 recipes:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Tomato Soup[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Sour Rye Soup (Żurek)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Rosol[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Ruskie Pierogi[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Pierogi with strawberries[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Rice with strawberries[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Pasta with cheese[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Simple Dinner[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Croquettes[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Boiled fruits drink (Kompot)[/color][/*]
[/list]
